courses.title: Introduction to Psychology
courses.description: Survey of the science of behavior and mental processes, including learning, cognition, development, social behavior and psychological disorders.

courses.title: Statistics in Psychology
courses.description: Descriptive and inferential statistics used in psychological research, hypothesis testing, correlation and regression.

courses.title: Research Methods in Psychology
courses.description: Design, conduct and reporting of psychological research; experimental and survey methods, measurement, research ethics, and scientific writing.

courses.title: Social Psychology
courses.description: How people think about, influence and relate to one another: attitudes, persuasion, group dynamics, conformity and prejudice.

courses.title: Developmental Psychology
courses.description: Physical, cognitive and social development across the lifespan.

courses.title: Cognitive Psychology
courses.description: Attention, perception, memory, language, reasoning and decision making from an information-processing perspective.

courses.title: Biological Bases of Behavior
courses.description: Neural and hormonal foundations of behavior, brain structure and function, sensation and motivation.

courses.title: Abnormal Psychology
courses.description: Classification, causes and treatment of psychological disorders.

courses.title: Industrial-Organizational Psychology
courses.description: Psychology applied to the workplace: personnel selection, performance appraisal, training, leadership, work teams, job attitudes and organizational culture.

courses.title: Psychology of Work Motivation
courses.description: Theories of motivation at work, goal setting, engagement, burnout, and employee well-being in modern organizations.

courses.title: Human Factors and Engineering Psychology
courses.description: Designing systems, interfaces and automation around human capabilities; human-automation trust, usability, error and workload.

courses.title: Judgment and Decision Making
courses.description: Heuristics, biases and rational choice; how people and algorithms make decisions under uncertainty.

courses.title: Cognitive Neuroscience
courses.description: Neural mechanisms of perception, memory, attention and executive function; neuroimaging methods.

courses.title: Clinical Psychology
courses.description: Assessment, psychotherapy approaches and professional practice in clinical psychology.

courses.title: Capstone: Research in Organizational Psychology
courses.description: Writing-intensive capstone in which students design and conduct an original research project on workplace behavior.

courses.title: Capstone: Clinical Science
courses.description: Writing-intensive capstone in clinical science research.
